verdict.rationale: Anytype's developer portal announces a first-party Anytype CLI that runs Anytype as a headless server for automation and scripting, so the product does ship an official CLI. The evidence is a single announcement line with no command reference, install guide or agent-oriented usage docs, so how deep it goes is unproven. Missing for 10: CLI command/reference documentation, installation and auth details, evidence of AI-agent-oriented CLI workflows, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Anytype CLI is now available - run Anytype as a headless server for automation and scripting.
